commit_message: Generalize Animation Set motion source references
pr_title: Implement ADR 0110 humanoid profiles and motion
pr_body:
Continues ADR 0110 implementation. This stage bumps Animation Set documents to schema v2 and persists explicit Auto, Native, or Humanoid motion-source policy together with stable imported asset IDs. Old v1 documents are rejected rather than silently migrated, matching ADR 0091. Editor Native selection remains a convenience over the tagged contract while runtime and packaging consumers are adapted to the new stable reference type.
